faq.q: What is the minimum pickup price?
faq.a: $85 for eligible curbside or garage pickup. Final pricing depends on volume, weight, dump fees, and specialty disposal.
A photo tells the crew more than a call. Text a few shots and get a firm quote and a pickup window.

faq.q: Do you serve my city or county?
faq.a: Yes — all Minnesota cities and counties, with route-aware scheduling.

faq.q: When is the soonest you can pick up?
faq.a: Most pickups are about two business days out; same-day is sometimes available based on crew capacity.

faq.q: What items do you NOT accept?
faq.a: Hazardous waste (paint, chemicals, pesticides, motor oil), medical waste, asbestos, biological waste, and explosives.

faq.q: Do you recycle or donate items?
faq.a: Yes — donation-first. Furniture to Bridging/Arc/Savers, electronics to R2-certified recyclers, mattresses to certified MN facilities.
